notes.initial: Three windows on a patterned desktop; Files is on top (focused) and overlaps the bottom of Notes; the taskbar lists all three.
notes.raised: Notes is focused and now drawn over Files where they overlap.
notes.moved: Notes moved by the drag offset (+14, +4) and now spans columns 18 to 61 and rows 7 to 22.
notes.resized-window: Calculator was resized from its corner to 34×23 and is now focused and on top.
notes.closed: Files was closed with its [×] button and is gone from the desktop and the taskbar; Calculator keeps the focus.
notes.maximized: Calculator fills the whole desktop between the menu bar and the taskbar.
notes.restored-and-cycled: Calculator is back to its previous size and position; F6 focused and raised Notes.
notes.resized-terminal: After shrinking the terminal to 90x28, both windows were moved (or shrunk) to stay fully on screen.
